entries.display_date_evidence: OFFICE AFMRS 30 December 1947 SUBJECT: Flying Discs

Description: 'On September 12, 2023 the Mexican Congress heard testimony on UAP from experts including... former U.S. Navy pilot Ryan Graves'; cable itself dated Sep 16, 2023 (DTG 160150Z SEP 23) on page 1. display_date uses the hearing date (Sep 12), not the cable authoring date (Sep 16), since the editorial relevance of this card is the hearing event.
